name: Vision Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Vision Corporation Ltd is in the business of Movies and Entertainment.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
VCL started as a paint company and is currently 
engaged in the business of TV Channels, Film making, and distribution, and related activities in Mumbai. It also used to publish a magazine 
called Films Today in Hindi and English.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.75 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 54.9 to 40.5 days.
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 6.15% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 56.1 days to 81.3 days
